purpose: Produce an exact official A-share active-universe authority for each prospective signal date D before any V2.8.3 price materialization.

baseline.role: bootstrap previous known universe only; never silently treated as unchanged for later D

SSE.role: official current Main-A and STAR membership

date_semantics.capture_window: after D close and no later than D+1 23:59:59 Asia/Shanghai

reconciliation.previous_universe: latest earlier PASS V2.8.3 PIT date universe; bootstrap from V2.7.31 if none exists
reconciliation.additions: Allowed when present in official current source and official_list_date <= D.
reconciliation.removals: A disappearance from the previous universe must be explained by an authoritative delist/termination date <= D. Otherwise the whole D authority is BLOCKED_UNRESOLVED_REMOVAL.
reconciliation.future_removal_policy: If the frozen ledger cannot resolve a prospective removal, do not infer its date. A separately versioned targeted official removal resolver is required.

pass_output.authority_time: GitHub committed_at timestamp of the PIT authority file creation commit

fail_closed: Either exchange source capture/parse is implausible.
A prior member disappears without an authoritative delist date <= D.
Source capture falls outside the D post-close cutoff.
The date is before V2.8.3 activation or not in the frozen joint calendar.
forbidden: Do not use AlphaDojo stock_info as official PIT membership authority.
Do not carry the 2026-09-20 universe forward without a new official observation.
Do not infer removal dates from vendor price disappearance.
Do not compute V2.8.3 factor outcomes in this layer.

problem_elimination.delete: No full issuer/filing re-materialization is required for this U-layer factor confirmation.
problem_elimination.avoid: Any unresolved removal blocks before the 300MB price download.
problem_elimination.absorb: Reuse the official SSE/SZSE current-list access already validated in V2.7.x and the frozen V2.8.1 historical delist ledger.
problem_elimination.substitute: Resolve only actual removal deltas prospectively instead of re-downloading complete historical delist catalogs every day.
problem_elimination.precompute_reuse: Carry the last PASS universe only as the comparison base; each new D still requires a fresh official current-list observation.
problem_elimination.optimize: Routine daily capture remains lightweight relative to price materialization.
